how_to_apply: Print the application form attached to the notice on thick white A4-size paper. The form is also on the Zilla Parishad, Chandrapur website.

Fill in the form legibly. Every field is mandatory, and an incomplete form will be rejected. The form asks for your personal and contact details, the languages you know, your computer proficiency, your education, your work experience (with 30 to 50 words on your responsibilities), your notice period and a signed declaration.
Put the form and all documents in an envelope and seal it.
On the envelope, write the name of the post you are applying for, your full name, your address and your mobile number.
Send the envelope by post, or hand it in, at the Health Department, Zilla Parishad, Chandrapur, during office hours except on holidays, by 4:00 pm on 6 November 2026.
Applications received after the deadline will not be accepted. The Health Department is not responsible if an application arrives late or does not arrive for any reason.
Final-year marksheet of the required educational qualification
For technical posts, a valid registration certificate from the relevant council

content_sections.heading: About ZP Chandrapur
content_sections.text: Zilla Parishad, Chandrapur is the district council of Chandrapur district in Maharashtra. It is running this recruitment together with the District Mineral Foundation (DMF). The doctors are being hired under the DMF to strengthen mother and child health services in Jiwati, which the notice calls an aspirational taluka. The posts will be filled under an agreement made by the Zilla Parishad's Health Department.

rows.event: Last date to submit the application

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: All applications will be screened. The selection process will be held only for candidates found eligible after screening. The list of eligible and ineligible candidates, along with any later notices about this recruitment, will be published only on the Zilla Parishad, Chandrapur website and on the notice board at the office where applications are received. Candidates will not be informed individually. The candidate does not have the prescribed eligibility. The candidate's previous service record shows administrative or financial proceedings, punitive action, or a criminal or other serious offence of any kind. The application is not in the prescribed format or is not filled in properly. The application is incomplete, filled in wrongly, or has overwriting. The application is unsigned, lacks self-attested copies of the required marksheets and certificates, or does not give the required details properly.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: These posts are not state government posts and are not under any mission. They are being filled on an experimental basis to strengthen health services in Jiwati taluka. The appointment depends on funds from the District Mineral Foundation. It is purely contractual, on an honorarium basis, under an agreement made by the Health Department, Zilla Parishad, Chandrapur. If the agreement is cancelled, the service will end immediately without prior notice, and no complaint will be heard. Candidates will have no claim to a permanent post, and government service rules do not apply to these posts.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are in ZP Chandrapur Advertisement 01/2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 posts: one Gynecologist, one Pediatrician and one Mobile Gynecologist. All of them are under the District Mineral Foundation, in Jiwati taluka.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification do I need for the Pediatrician post?
faq.answer: You need MBBS + MD (Pediatrics) / DCH / DNB. You also need a valid registration certificate from the relevant council.

faq.question: Q3. Can I apply online?
faq.answer: No. Print the form on thick white A4 paper, then send it by post or hand it in at the Health Department, Zilla Parishad, Chandrapur.

faq.question: Q4. What should I write on the envelope?
faq.answer: Write the name of the post you are applying for, your full name, your address and your mobile number.

faq.question: Q5. What is the deadline?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the office by 4:00 pm on 6 November 2026. You can submit during office hours on any day except holidays.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the Mobile Gynecologist work?
faq.answer: The Mobile Gynecologist will tour primary health centres, sub-centres and remote villages in Jiwati taluka. The work includes screening and following up high-risk pregnant women, running specialist ANC clinics and providing referral support.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely contractual, on an honorarium basis, and depends on DMF funds. You will have no claim to a permanent post, government service rules do not apply, and the service ends immediately if the agreement is cancelled.

faq.question: Q8. Do I need a domicile certificate?
faq.answer: Yes. A self-attested copy of a domicile certificate or residence certificate is one of the four documents you must attach.

faq.question: Q9. How will I find out if I am eligible?
faq.answer: The list of eligible and ineligible candidates will be published on zpchandrapur.maharashtra.gov.in and on the notice board at the office where applications are received. Candidates will not be informed individually.
